instruction: A Monstera deliciosa houseplant in a ceramic pot: several large heart-shaped leaves with characteristic split fenestration holes on thick arching stems, some leaves drooping. Botanically readable, glossy green foliage.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a Monstera plant in a ceramic pot. A Monstera deliciosa houseplant in a ceramic pot: several large heart-shaped leaves with characteristic split fenestration holes on thick arching stems, some leaves drooping. Botanically readable, glossy green foliage. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
